en:
Captain, it looks like this resupply went
well. Reimi and the others who went
shopping seem to have relieved some
stress, too.
Wow, it looks great on you! It\nwas definitely worth splurging\non!
They're quite lively, aren't\nthey? I wonder if they found\nsomething nice?

I wondered what you were buying, but
these clothes look quite expensive. Are
you sure you want me to be the first to
wear them?

Because you'll look the best in
it, Nel! Of course, I'll wear it
later too, and I'll call everyone
else so we can all swap outfits!
You've certainly got energy...\nWell, I'm honestly grateful that\nyou thought it would suit me.
Oh my! How glamorous! It looks\nquite old; is it some kind of\nantique?

Yeah, apparently it's a relic left behind
by a people who once flourished in this
sector. They say it's incredibly valuable,
both historically and artistically.

I see, ancient ethnic clothing. It is
lovely. It possesses a blend of primitive
strength and progressive delicacy... so
to speak.
Yes, yes! This is some fine\ncraftsmanship. By the way, how\nmuch did it cost?
That's expensive...!?
Right, it was so expensive that\nI could only buy one for a man\nand one for a woman.

Y-you bought two of those at
that price?! Where on earth did
the budget for that come
from?!

...What is it? I thought I heard a
racket on the ship, but you're
all just getting worked up over
something pointless again.
Ah, Albel! Perfect timing! I have\na men's outfit, so would you\nmind trying it on?
Hmph. I'd rather be asleep than\nwaste my time on such a\nchildish game.
Oh... He shot me down\ninstantly. And I really thought it\nwould look good on him.

He has no sense of
cooperation... Even if he was
going to refuse, he could have
been a bit more polite.

Hmm... Come to think of it, is the
culture that made these clothes from
the people of Planet Augus? I heard
something about them during our last
resupply.

Yes, the fallen Planet Augus.
Apparently, after a series of events,
the inhabitants perished, leaving behind
a desolate world of ruins and a few
scattered relics.

The environment is in terrible shape,
and the ruins where the local gods
were enshrined are said to be
dangerous―so much so that even tomb
raiders won't go near them now.

I heard some space merchants were
worried because there's some eccentric
scholar trying to poke around those
dangerous ruins on that wasteland of a
planet.

I thought I'd like to check
things out if the ship happened
to pass by... I didn't realize this
clothing originated from there.

Augus was listed on the star chart you
bought for me at the resupply station.
We're actually passing nearby right
now... Shall we stop and take a look?

Hmm... This planet is certainly in a
terrible state. It's right on the edge of
being habitable... actually, it's just
barely uninhabitable.

There are signs that a small
craft landed here very
recently. I wonder if it belongs
to that scholar.
Hmm... But for such a desolate\nplanet, there's a strange\nenergy? And it's amplifying...!
What do you mean!?

N-now that you mention it, I heard the
god worshipped by the people of Augus
was a violent deity... one that brought
calamity to anyone who approached
carelessly.

Once provoked, the god would continue
to cause disasters until it was satisfied,
and the planet grew more desolate with
every occurrence...

There's even a theory that
these traditional clothes were
originally the attire of dancers
meant to appease the god.

...The scholar is a young man
eager for fame, and apparently,
he was trying to investigate
that very god of Augus.

This is definitely a case of
someone provoking something
that should have been left
alone!

Hmm, this is not good. If left
unchecked, this is the kind of energy
that could strip the entire surface of
the planet bare.
For everyone's safety, I believe\nwe should leave immediately...\nhowever.

Even on a planet where the
inhabitants have perished, I
believe the remnants of their
culture should be protected!

Especially when a superior past culture
is erased just because some scholar
from an advanced planet was
careless―we can't let that happen!

Indeed. It would be cruel to
simply overlook this while we
are here. We may have the
power to stop it.

I'd expect that from Reimi and
Nel, though maybe not from
Albel. That's what makes you
two so wonderful, though.

Well, from a Federation moral
standpoint, we can't exactly ignore this.
Let's get this situation under control,
Captain. Landing now!
The air is... barely breathable.\nBut I have a terrible feeling. It's\nlike a storm is about to hit...!

Yes, this feels far too abnormal. We
must hurry. There's no time to change
clothes, but we must find the scholar's
traces...
Gishaaaa!

What?! What are these things?
This environment shouldn't
have been capable of
supporting native life!

Are these creatures from the
Demon Realm? Could the "god"
of this place actually be from
the Demon Realm...?!

Understood! I'll issue an
emergency request for
assistance to everyone on
board the ship!!
If we don't hold them here, the\nship will be in danger.\nEveryone, let's do this!

Phew... we managed to repel them. That
was a terrifying number of enemies. We
would have been overwhelmed if the
entire crew hadn't fought together.
You're right, it was truly thanks\nto everyone's cooperation!
...Or so I thought, but it seems\nAlbel was the only one resting\nin his room...

I can't believe he could sleep
through an emergency like this.
Talk about a lack of team
spirit.

I-I'm sure he was just
exhausted! He seemed to be
leading the charge in the last
battle, too.
Come to think of it, I feel kind\nof tired... Ugh... so... tired...
A-Are you okay, Reimi? You\nlook way too sick for it to be\njust exhaustion!

...Wait, something's wrong with
the others too!? A-And my own
body... my movements are
slowing down...!
Ugh, *cough*...!
Reimi! What's happening!\nEveryone else is... suddenly\ncollapsing...!

There must be something harmful in
this planet's air... something our senses
and equipment can't detect...! *cough
cough*...!

Everyone on the crew... no, Coro,
everyone with a mechanical body,
please evacuate to the ship
immediately! Before you end up like me!
Ugh... ah...
Reimi, stay with me! I'll carry\nyou out of here, so just hang\non!

*Cough*... I'll be fine. I have a unique
constitution that allows me to adapt to
environments quickly. I'll recover soon,
so Nel, please... evacuate and leave
me...!
Dammit... I can't just leave\nReimi when she's in this much\npain...
Wait, why am I the only one\nwho's okay...? I-I mean, why am\nI actually safe?
Even Coro, who's made of\nmachinery, is acting strange...

It's likely... those traditional
clothes. Traditional attire is
often optimized for surviving in
a specific region.
*Cough*... You must have some\nkind of resistance to this\ntoxin... *Cough, cough*...!

I see! If Reimi wears these
clothes, she'll be...! Here, Reimi,
I know it's hard, but put these
on...

You mustn't take them off!
You're the only one who can
still move properly, Nel! *Cough,
cough*...!
...No, one more. There might be\none other person who escaped\nthe effects...!
...I've got the situation. You\nmeddling pests.

This is what happens when you
play the hero and stick your
nose into the affairs of a dying
planet.

It's a miracle that you sleeping in your
room through the emergency alerts
actually worked in our favor. Now, help
everyone evacuate.

They chose to set foot on a
dangerous planet of their own
free will. Let them find their
own way back.

If the captain and the others stay
down, we're all wiped out along with
this planet. If you don't want to die,
shut up, put on this suit, and get to
work.
...Tch, why do I have to wear a\nsuit like this...

*Sigh*... Is everyone back inside the
ship? It looks like they can't move right
away, even after getting out of the
atmosphere.

I just brought Reimi in last, but
she hasn't recovered yet. The
others will likely take even
longer.
We might need to escape this\nplanet... but we can't operate\nthe ship.

So we just wait for this "divine curse"
to wear off? At this rate, some of
those soft-hearted idiots are going to
end up dead.

I know that without you telling
me! If that's the case, we have
no choice but to cut the
problem off at the root!
I'll find that strange scholar\nand put a stop to this!
*Pant*... *pant*... No sign of the\nscholar here either...

You're slow. The best stealth
agent in Aquaria is dragging
her feet. Are you slacking off
in a situation like this?

I'm trained differently than a combat
maniac like you. Besides, the surface of
this planet is far too desolate to walk
through easily...

Don't make excuses, you pest. You're
just under-trained. No matter the
situation or who you are, if you can't
move, you're just dead weight.

I can't believe the Aquaria army is run
by such weaklings. I should've just
launched an all-out attack and crushed
them already.

It's reassuring to see you still
have enough energy to spout
insults. It looks like our
destination is close.

There are signs of recent
activity in that cave over
there. That must be the temple
ruins.

I see. No wonder I can sense
enemies. There's a fair number
of them lying in wait. Get
ready, Nel!

*Sigh*... We ended up fighting our way
right into the cave. From the looks of
it... this area seems to have been a
residential district.

There must have been grand buildings
here once, but most of them have
returned to the earth. The environment
of this planet must have been truly
harsh.

It seems the inhabitants of this world
were a very sturdy people, possessing
horns like the ornaments on this outfit,
but even so, their lives must have been
difficult.

On a ruined planet like this,
being "sturdy" doesn't get you
very far. It's only natural that
they went extinct.

There is no such thing as a people who
deserve to go extinct. Especially a
people capable of creating such
superior art as these clothes... it is a
tragedy that they are gone.

Hmph. That's why they lost the fight for
survival―because they wasted their energy on
things like art. Whether it was the gods or the
environment, if they'd just crushed everything
with raw power, they might still be alive.

It doesn't matter if you leave clothes
behind; if you lose and perish, it's all
over. No matter what it takes... the one
who survives in the end is the winner.

If you lose, it's over. I agree with you
there. Since we carry the lives of
everyone on the ship, we cannot afford
to lose either.
That's why... I'll leave the rest...\nto you...
...What's wrong? Stop messing\naround. Get up. Get up and\nkeep moving.
Sorry, but I don't think I can\nstand. It seems the protection\nof these clothes had its limits.

You don't know when the same thing
might happen to you. There's no time.
Hurry and find that scholar and stop
him! I'm told he's a young man in black
clothes and a black hat.
Do you intend to just rot away\nhere?
Don't make me say it.
Hmph... Interesting.
Whoa, what are you doing?\nS-stop it, Albel! What do you\nthink you're...!
Quiet, you fool, or the enemy\nwill notice us. Just... stay on\nmy back.

...What is the meaning of this?
If you're trying to put me in
your debt, I refuse. Just leave
me behind; I'm only a burden.

Are you mocking me? I told you my
training is on a different level. Carrying
one woman isn't going to make me a
burden.

Besides, it's not for your sake. These
clothes... if I keep two of them in close
contact, the effect might be stronger
and last longer.
Cl... close contact!? Don't say\nsuch ridiculous things! Let go!\nL-let me go!

What, you've recovered enough
strength to make all that noise? It
seems it actually worked. In that case,
we move out.

Unlike you, I have absolutely no
intention of rotting away on this planet.
I'll get those soft-hearted fools healed
and put an end to this nuisance.
For that purpose, I'm willing to\ncarry someone who was once\nthe enemy. That's all.

...Fine. Sorry for making a
scene. Since it's to save
everyone's lives, I'll rely on your
back for a while.

The footprints around here are
especially fresh. They lead that
way. Yes, go through that
collapsed section.

The cross-section of the collapse is
brand new. And the dust is still... It
seems the source of this mess is
indeed close.
Hm, the man in black...! So\nthat's the scholar.
It looks like it... but he's just\nstanding there? Something\nseems off...
For that matter, how is he fine\nwithout wearing the traditional\nethnic clothing?
...OOOOOOOOOO!
Damn it, wh-what is that?! Do\nyou see it, Nel?!
I see it! Something glowing has\nappeared above the scholar...!
Is it linked to the scholar...? Is\nit possessing him?! Could that\nbe the god of this planet?
...OOOOOOOOOO!
Ah! The cave... it's cracking!
*Gah*... *cough, cough*! What's\nthis? Suddenly I can't\nbreathe...!

Is that god spreading the toxic
air of this planet...? If so, if we
can stop its activity... if we can
appease it...!

But how...!? Reimi said we had
to wait until the god's
presence cleared, but what
can we do?
...Looks like we don't have time\nto think. That thing spotted us!
...OOOOOOOOOOO!
...Ooooh...
Huh? The guy suddenly went\nquiet.
Ugh...
Oh, the scholar collapsed. And\nthe god... has it vanished?

What, did the so-called god
just calm down? Well, it
certainly tore things up enough
for us.

Heh... Or maybe it lost
consciousness because I gave
that nuisance of a scholar a
good kick?
You did that? ...Well, I secretly\nlanded a few hits myself.

Good grief. I braced myself for
a death match with a god, but
it ended before things even
got interesting.
As if that would be interesting.\nHonestly...

Still, everyone suffered terribly because
of this scholar. We need to restrain him
properly and hand him over to the
authorities.
Ho, looks like you're feeling\nbetter now that he's out of the\npicture?

Now that you mention it... I
suppose the harmful air
vanished once the god was
appeased.
I see... In that case, those\nsoft-hearted fools should be on\nthe mend as well.

What's this? You were more worried
about the Captain and the others than
I thought. I thought this was all just a
"nuisance" to you?

Who would worry about a bunch of
idiots who went out of their way to get
mixed up in trouble?! This pointless job
is finally over!
I don't need these flashy,\nrestrictive clothes anymore\neither!

Wa-wait, you're planning to strip right
here?! You didn't bring a change of
clothes! I don't need you flashing me
any more than you already have!!
Huh? I couldn't care less\nwhether it bothers you or not!
Ju-just stop trying to undress\nhere! Do it once you're back in\nyour room on the ship!
Tsk, you're so noisy. Fine, let's\njust get back.

I'll carry the scholar. But if you
wear me out on the way back
like you did coming here, I'm
leaving you behind!
Yeah, yeah, I get it!

This story has come to an end.
More stories are planned for
release in the future. Please
look forward to them.
Hah! Yahhh!!
...Weren't you just knocked out\na moment ago? You seem\nawfully energetic.

I'm still feeling a bit dizzy,
actually. But I didn't want to
keep taking up space in that
crowded infirmary.

Then you should just rest in
your room. Are you really that
desperate to play with that
"Fayt Simulator" thing?
...The "Fayt" Simulator? Didn't\nyou mean the "Fight"\nSimulator?
...What are you talking about? I\nsaid "Fight." I didn't mistake it\nfor your name.

You did. You said Fayt. Did I
worry you so much that my
name is on your lips? Or do
you just want to simulate me?

Who would want to simulate the likes of
you?! Whatever, just go play with your
"Fight Simulator" for the rest of the
day!

Hahaha, I'm not going to do
anything this physically
demanding right after being
sick. But...

This whole thing made me
realize something. Just how
inexperienced I am, to be taken
down so easily...
It was a disaster. Every single\none of you was knocked out\ntogether.
Not necessarily.

While I was lying there unable
to move, the Captain, Cliff, and
even Maria were gritting their
teeth to help everyone.
I felt pathetic, not being able\nto move a single finger.
That's why I didn't come to the\nFight Simulator just to play.
I came to the Battle Simulator\nto harden my resolve.

Hmph. From where I stand, everyone on
this ship is just a bunch of
good-natured fools who stick their
noses into everything without
considering their own limits.
Hehe, in that case, you're one\nof those good-natured fools\ntoo, since you helped us.
I've heard how things ended.\nSorry for the trouble we\ncaused you, Albel.

Damn it, who's the good-natured one? I
only act for my own sake. If you lot
stayed knocked out forever, this ship
wouldn't even move.

Cyuss and Arumat, you're both
back on your feet too. That's a
relief. But what are you doing
here?

Same as you. If I let something
like this take me down, I'd be a
disgrace to the name of the
Reaper.
After being out for that long,\nI've gotta move around or I'll\nget rusty.
What the―?! You two, were you\nlistening to everything I just\nsaid?!
Yeah, we heard every word\nfrom the start!

*Sigh*... Since the cat's out of the bag,
I'm going to need you two to help me
out. Albel, you too, of course. Even if
you're recovering, don't hold back―
Ugh...
Hey!!
You okay, Fayt?! Maybe you\nshould've stayed in bed!
Sorry for worrying you. I just\nfelt a bit dizzy, but I'm fine\nnow.
Put this on.
Huh?

Apparently, these clothes repel the
toxic substances that knocked you
guys out. It should speed up your
recovery a bit.
...Um, you mean the thing\nyou're wearing right now,\nAlbel? I think... I'll pass on that.
What? You want to stay a\npatient forever?
No, I mean, of course I want to\nget better quickly, but...

That outfit is basically open in
the front; it's like being naked.
We aren't even at the beach, I
can't wear something like that.

Huh? Sure, the waist and
sleeves are a bit cluttered, but
the upper body is relatively
comfortable.

You might not mind since you
always have your stomach and
thighs exposed, Albel... but it's
embarrassing, right?
Hmm, embarrassing? Being\nshirtless?
Hmph, who cares. I don't\nbother myself with what others\nwear.
Fayt, what are you trying to\nsay? What's the problem with\nthis outfit?

Ugh, I can't get through to any of you
three... If I walked around the ship
dressed like that, I'd definitely be a
laughingstock.
A laughingstock, you say...\nWhat is wrong with my clothes!!
No, I mean, I'm used to yours,\nAlbel, so it's fine! Nobody cares\nabout that!
That means if people aren't\nused to it, they'll laugh at me!

Dammit, I thought I'd go easy
on you since you were just
passed out, but this is
ridiculous!

Put the clothes on! And get
fully recovered this instant!!
Then I'm going to tear you to
shreds!!

Whoa, stop it! Don't take it out
on someone who's just
recovering! Don't strip me!
Don't take it off~~!
That was quite an ordeal... but\nI'm just glad everyone has\nrecovered.

Now then, as originally planned,
let's have a fashion show with
the traditional clothing of
Augus!
I figured I'd be the first one to\ntry it on...
As expected of Lady Nel! It\nlooks great on you!

Wawa, you look so cool! With Lady Nel's
charm, men and women alike will be
head over heels! One hit and they're
dead!

I see, so this is the dancer's
attire of Augus said to
appease the God of Calamity.
And it actually worked.

I wonder if that thing calmed
down because we fought while
wearing these... though there's
no way to check now.

Hehe... the outfit is beautiful, and so is
the person wearing it. Anyone would be
mesmerized and forget all about their
anger.

Hmm? These patterns look a bit like
Symbology. I wonder if it's a unique
local development. It's interesting, but...
I don't really get it.

Yeah! Regardless of the
complicated stuff, the design is
lovely! Such mature sexiness,
it's so cool!

The painting and dyeing aside,
the structure itself doesn't
seem too difficult. I might be
able to make something similar!

Let's see, this piece of fabric
goes here and the lining goes
there... I really want to try it on
to be sure. Hey, can I go next?
Hey, no fair, Miki! I want to try\nit on too! I wonder how the obi\npart is made?
H-hey, stop pulling! You'll make\nit come open. I'm not wearing\nmuch underneath!
It's fine! I'm already wearing\nsomething underneath! See, like\nthis!
Even if you're fine, Millie, I'm\nnot!
My, my. In that case... I'm glad I\nbrought those clothes.
*Sigh*... I can't deal with Millie\nand the others. I'll step away\nuntil things calm down.
But Clair, why on earth did you\nbring those clothes...?

Since you said it was a fashion
show, I brought them out
thinking I'd let someone try
them on.
But then again, Nel might be\nthe one who can pull those\nclothes off best.

Yes, Lady Nel is the best! At
least I couldn't pull off those
clothes or the ones from
before!
Oh, but wait! If we're talking\nabout what suits Lady Nel, that\nfallen angel outfit was better!
Oh, that one was great too. It\nreally suited her...!

If we're thinking of other things
for Nel to wear... Oh, I think a
wedding dress would look
lovely on her.
A wedding dress! That would\nbe wonderful. I'd love to try\none on myself someday...

I can just wear one. Welch
once made a "wedding dress"
in the form of a power suit, so
why not ask her?
Not if Welch is making it!""
If Welch made it, it would\ndefinitely have some weird\nfunctions built in.
(But that's what makes it\ninteresting...)

Besides, her sense of style is a bit
too... provocative. Who knows what kind
of outfit she'd come up with if she just
let her creativity run wild...

Oh, that's exactly the kind of
outfit I'd want to see Nel and
Clair wearing while they walk
the runway!

Stop. Stop imagining it. I don't
know what you're picturing, but
it's not something incredibly
revealing, is it?

It's fine. In terms of how much
skin shows, I don't think it
would be much different from
what you're wearing now.
Why are you being so specific?\nJust what are you seeing,\nClair...?
I heard something about a\nfashion show, so I hurried over!\nIs everyone having fun, nyan?
Oh, Nel! Clair! You've already\nchanged! You both look\nwonderful!

Ah, yeah. Your outfit is nice
too, Sophia. Those ribbons look
like Meracle's ears; they're very
cute.
Thank you! I love how cute\nthey are! You look great too,\nNel―like a cool, mature woman!

Such cute clothes... You know,
since we're having a fashion
show, why don't you two try
swapping outfits?
Oh, that sounds like a great\nidea! I'd love to see Nel looking\ncute!

W-wait a minute. I was just
forced to change into this.
Besides, isn't Sophia's outfit a
bit too cute for me to wear?

True, sexy looks suit Nel
better. In that case, I have
some clothes I borrowed from
Maria!
Let's see, let me have a look.\nOh... does this have rabbit\nears? I love it!

That's the outfit from when we
infiltrated the casino. It's wonderful! I
want to dress Lady Nel and Lady Clair
in those, knock them to the floor, and
just stare at them!
E-enough already! Why is\neveryone so obsessed with\ndressing me up?!
Farleen, Tynave! If you want it\nthat badly, I'll make you two\nwear them first! Clair, you too!
My, it seems things are heating\nup over there as well. How\nlovely.

Now then, including the outfits
we've brought along, shall we
begin the second act of our
fashion show!
